context.live_defect: Live anchor submission was silently refused by Sogni and the worker polled a phantom project until retry exhaustion (job 8b20d350, providerRef 1834D73B, terminal MEDIA_UNAVAILABLE 'Project not found'). Exact refusal captured by a probe with SDK event listeners: WebSocket jobError 4007 'Unsupported size preset option: 1080p'. Root cause: buildSdkParameters' image branch forwards the render-settings resolution string verbatim as sizePreset; Sogni only accepts known preset ids. The proven story-side mapping (lib/providers/sogni/request-maps.ts toImageParams) uses sizePreset 'custom' + explicit width/height = aspect base (lib/constants.ts ASPECTS) x resolution scale (RESOLUTIONS.scale), snapped to multiples of 8. Note the SDK generates project ids client-side and resolves create() right after the socket send; refusals only surface as client.projects 'project' error events, which the production transport does not consume — polling then fails with 'Project not found' (retry exhaustion terminates the job cleanly today; a fail-fast listener is a worthwhile follow-up, NOT in this packet).

sdk-parameters-dimensions.change: In buildSdkParameters (lib/providers/production/sogni-provider.ts:151): (1) IMAGE branch — replace `sizePreset: resolution` with the story-proven shape: `sizePreset: 'custom'`, `width` and `height` computed from the shared aspect base and resolution scale — import { ASPECTS, RESOLUTIONS } from "../../constants"; width = snap8(ASPECTS[aspect].width * (RESOLUTIONS[resolution]?.scale ?? 1)), height likewise; snap8(v) = Math.max(8, Math.round(v / 8) * 8) (local helper, same semantics as request-maps). Unknown aspect falls back to the 16:9 base; unknown resolution falls back to scale 1. (2) VIDEO branch, H3 modes only (mode !== 'unknown') — add `width`/`height` via the existing verified helper minimaxH3Dimensions(aspect, resolution) imported from "../sogni/video-limits" (check the exact export signature before use) so H3 takes render on the requested 9:16 grid instead of the server default; non-H3 video branches stay unchanged. Keep every other field byte-identical.
